outcome_evidence: The robot approaches and aligns with the upper drawer handle (frames 0–67, image and wrist_image), closes its gripper around the handle (frames 68–74, wrist_image), and pulls the drawer outward (frames 88–105, image and left_ego_image). The drawer interior and extended sides are visible, and the drawer remains open as the gripper releases and withdraws at frames 118–125 (image, left_ego_image, and wrist_image). No failed attempt or unintended side effect is visible.
